fields.mechanism: Integration of throttle position sensor components directly into the throttle body manufacturing process to eliminate moisture ingress paths at assembly interfaces
fields.intervention: Replace the 2017 Honda Civic electronic throttle body with a unit manufactured using integrated throttle position sensor component assembly, eliminating separate sensor-to-body mating surfaces where water collects and causes dielectric constant changes that shift the Hall-effect or potentiometric signal during moisture exposure
fields.expected_effect: Throttle position sensor output remains stable after car wash exposure, preventing high idle and rough running without requiring throttle cycling to clear residual moisture from sensor gaps
fields.falsification_test: Spray the replacement integrated-sensor throttle body with pressurized water at 30 psi for 60 seconds simulating a car wash, then immediately measure TPS voltage at closed throttle; if voltage deviates more than 0.02V from the dry baseline, the mechanism is falsified
